AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an organisation that is allocated by an institution, eg, Dun & Bradstreet Identification.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier, as assigned to a financial institution using a proprietary identification scheme.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.
